newsitem.title: USA: King World sets dividend, share buyback.
newsitem.headline: King World sets dividend, share buyback.

text.p: King World Productions Inc said its board of directors has declared a special dividend of $2 per common share and authorized a stock repurchase program for up to five million shares.
The repurchase program reflects about 13 percent of shares outstanding. The company said the special dividend will be payable on May 16, 1997 to shareholders of record on April 25, 1997.

King World said that under the share buyback, stock will be bought in the open market and in privately-negotiated transactions. The new program follows the recent completion of a four-year buyback under which the company bought two million shares for a total $71 million.
Purchased shares will be used for general corporate purposes.
In the future, the company's cash balance will be used for acquisitions and to fund production of new and existing programs, said Michael King, president and chief executive officer.
